title: Something’s Gotta Give | WaterColor Stunner | Exclusive 30A
h1: Somethings Gotta Give Movie Set Replica
meta_description: Experience Something’s Gotta Give, a designer WaterColor home 1 minute to the beach. Ideal for a unique and memorable stay.
description_expanded: Somethings Gotta Give Movie Set Replica - Southern Living Magazine cover star June/July 2022 - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, light shedding ok, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Designer interiors throughout the home. You will be impressed not only with the beauty of this home, but how easy it is enjoy yourself here - 1 Minute bike ride to WaterColor Beach Club, Wine World, Scratch Biscuit Kitchen, and WaterColor shopping - 1 Minute bike ride to Western Lake and Boathouse pool - 3 Minute bike ride to Seaside food trucks and shopping - Driveway Parking for 2 vehicles. Neighborhood parking available in front of home on a first come, first serve basis - All suite bedrooms including a three suites on the 1st floor - Steps to a beautiful pocket park - perfect for picnics and playtime with the kids and pup - Covered front porch with relaxing daybed swing, ceiling fans, curtains for privacy, and cushioned seating - Full open kitchen with high-end appliances and ample supply of kitchenware for your cooking needs - Spacious living room with Smart TV - Beautyrest Black mattresses - UV Filter on HVAC - Dining for 10 - 1st floor laundry closet with washer and dryer - Entire 2nd floor is a kids paradise with a private suite and TV - Outdoor shower next to back entrance of home - Propane outdoor grill - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all WaterColor community pools included with your reservation - Community pools heated during cooler months and towel service is available (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Concierge services including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and bike rentals available through Vacayzen. - Golf cart rentals available at Electric Cart Company as the exclusive vendor for the neighborhood. Reservations are limited, and we recommend reserving a cart as soon as possible - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee In the spirit of the original WaterColor Community, our perfectly located home in Phase 1 boasts quite possibly the most charming interiors in the neighborhood. Our bungalow-style retreat is a chic and fully redecorated getaway located on highly coveted Buttercup Street in the Park District of WaterColor. It's all about location in WaterColor and beautiful homes in convenient locations do not come easily - so book fast to grab it before someone else does. The spacious living area is filled with a multitude of windows, filling the home with natural sunlight. Fabulous antiques and accessories make this one of the most interesting and appealing homes in the community. The coastal living dining area opens to the kitchen for easy entertaining. The front porch acts as an additional living area. The daybed swing is a favorite, and we encourage naps on this comfy space covered by a ceiling fan. You will notice the admiring glances from walkers as they pass by the home, and you will want to spend as much time as possible on the front porch. Step out of your WaterColor hideaway and find yourself just across from 30A, only a few minute's walk to the Gulf of Mexico, the world-renowned and highly acclaimed WaterColor Beach Club, as well as the bustling town of Seaside! Kick off your shoes and sink your feet into the powdery, white sand while enjoying the gorgeous emerald waters. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, dresser and closet storage, ensuite bath with antique soaking tub and walk-in shower
1st Floor King Suite 2 | closet storage, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
1st Floor Queen Suite | closet storage, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor Kids Suite | sleeps up to 6 in two full size loft beds and two twin daybeds, TV, closet storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
